en: Job 29

p.src: 1  Job again took up his parable, and said,

en: Job again took up his parable, and said,
u.src: 1  Job again took up his parable, and said,

p.src: 2  “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

en: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
u.src: 2  “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

p.src: 3  when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

en: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,
u.src: 3  when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

p.src: 4  as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

en: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,
u.src: 4  as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

p.src: 5  when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

en: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,
u.src: 5  when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

p.src: 6  when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

en: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,
u.src: 6  when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

p.src: 7  when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

en: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
u.src: 7  when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

p.src: 8  The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

en: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.
u.src: 8  The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

p.src: 9  The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

en: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
u.src: 9  The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

p.src: 10  The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

en: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.
u.src: 10  The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

p.src: 11  For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,

en: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,
u.src: 11  For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,

p.src: 12  because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

en: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,
u.src: 12  because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

p.src: 13  the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

en: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
u.src: 13  the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

p.src: 14  I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.
u.src: 14  I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

p.src: 15  I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

en: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.
u.src: 15  I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

p.src: 16  I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.

en: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.
u.src: 16  I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.

p.src: 17  I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

en: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
u.src: 17  I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

p.src: 18  Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.

en: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.
u.src: 18  Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.

p.src: 19  My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

en: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.
u.src: 19  My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

p.src: 20  My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

en: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’
u.src: 20  My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

p.src: 21  “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

en: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.
u.src: 21  “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

p.src: 22  After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

en: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.
u.src: 22  After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

p.src: 23  They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

en: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.
u.src: 23  They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

p.src: 24  I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

en: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.
u.src: 24  I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

p.src: 25  I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

en: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
u.src: 25  I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.
